## MOSS 示例输出（规范示例；没有真实出图验证）

### A. Caption · 二次元人物 × 写实背景 × lo-fi（默认推荐）

`A quiet lo-fi illustration of a shy Japanese schoolgirl waiting beside a narrow residential street after school. She wears an oversized cream cardigan over her sailor-style uniform. Her fingers curl around the strap of her school bag, and she lowers her gaze with a small embarrassed smile when she notices someone just outside the frame.

The girl is distinctly hand-drawn in delicate 2D anime linework, with simplified cel-shaded skin and soft chestnut hair. The surrounding street looks like a real location photograph: weathered concrete, asphalt grain, a bicycle leaning beside a wall, and the pale reflections in an apartment window. The anime figure and photographic environment share the same overcast light direction and muted blue-grey color grade. A waist-up three-quarter view from the other side of the sidewalk, with a broad quiet stretch of background on the right; restrained contrast, slight analog softness, no staged pose.`

这属于我们自己的 **[Candidate] Caption**，不是官方风格触发词测试通过。

### B. Tags · 少量已确认为常见词的视觉概念

`1girl, solo, brown hair, school uniform, cardigan, blush, looking away, holding bag, upper body, outdoors, street, cloudy sky, muted colors`

此例演示**格式**，不代表每一个词已被 MOSS 训练验证；character / series 的确切 tag 需要来源验证。为了研究“纯靠风格词”，可以只用 Caption A 而不调用画师串。

### C. Layout · 可复制的模型最终 JSON（1024×1024）

`{"summary":{"meta":["album cover"],"canvas":"single","caption":"A quiet blue-grey lo-fi album cover combining a hand-drawn 2D anime girl with a realistic photographic street."},"items":[{"label":"character","caption":"A shy anime schoolgirl wearing a cream cardigan, looking downward on the left side of the frame.","bbox":[-272,-432,388,-12]},{"label":"text","caption":"Large off-white uppercase album title in the open upper-right area.","text":"AFTER SCHOOL","bbox":[-352,32,-224,428]}],"bbox_coord_space":"abs_centralized","bbox_format":"yxyx"}`

元信息中的画幅为 1024×1024，仅属于生成界面参数。排版需实际测试，特定 checkpoint 对文字与字符长度的识别可能不同。

### D. 多人画面 Caption 示意

`Two travelers stand on opposite sides of a glass door. The smaller figure in a pale green robe is nearest to the viewer, pressing her palm lightly against the glass. Behind it, a tall swordsman in dark blue lowers his gaze to the place where her hand meets the pane, his silver armored hand relaxed at his side. Reflections separate their faces while a single corridor ceiling light connects the two sides of the scene. Portrait orientation, observational eye-level view, minimal background distractions, restrained navy-and-sage palette.`

多人默认**一个完整 Caption**，不要搬 NAI5 的 Base/Character 区块语法。
